newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Payless ShoeSource a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Payless ShoeSource a buy.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Wednesday it rated Payless ShoeSource Inc a buy with a six-to-12-month price target of $45.

-- Gruntal said the move follows the company's previously announced $150-million share repurchase plan and its proposed acquisition of the Parade of Shoes chain from J. Baker Inc for an undisclosed price.

-- The two announcements could accelerate the growth potential of Payless, Gruntal said. The company also mentioned that sales were tracking with expectations during January, and Gruntal said it is still comfortable with its fiscal 1996 fourth-quarter earnings estimate of $0.35 a share.
-- Payless operates a chain of 4,261 footwear stores.
-- Its shares were trading up 1/2 Wednesday at 37-1/2.
